description: Measured multi-axle curvature and rear lateral scrub. Linear interpolation of curvature/tan(angle) ratios and slip angle.
conditions: approx 5 km/h, flat Town10HD intersection, 3m rear axle travel
anchors: All nonzero angle samples are measured. Zero angle is the straight-motion identity.
limits: Calibration at approx 5 km/h; not validated at all speeds, slopes, loads or server builds. Some full-reverse training arcs shorter than 3m; do not count as acceptance passes.
